confirmations.label: Structural owner
confirmations.scope: CAD correspondence to the intended physical system, configuration, rigidity and degrees of freedom, interface identity, zero pose, positive direction, and engineering changes
confirmations.automatic_exclusion: Do not repeat main-assembly uniqueness, instance coverage, rigid-body ownership, tree topology, coordinate transforms, or export consistency checks.

confirmations.label: Mechanical safety owner
confirmations.scope: Full travel, critical combinations, interference, clearance, tolerances, safety margins, and cable constraints
confirmations.automatic_exclusion: Do not repeat numeric limit validity or native-to-output limit consistency checks.

confirmations.label: Parameter owner
confirmations.scope: Output-side specification, transmission, continuous and peak duty, and applicability
confirmations.automatic_exclusion: Do not repeat already verified specification references, versions, values, or derivation consistency.

confirmations.label: Physical-parameter owner
confirmations.scope: Physical material, density, physical scope, overrides, and simplification provenance
confirmations.automatic_exclusion: Do not repeat CAD-to-URDF total mass, center of mass, inertia combination, units, or transform checks.

confirmations.label: Budget owner
confirmations.scope: Independence, scope, and uncertainty of a supplied budget
confirmations.automatic_exclusion: Do not repeat whether the artifact falls inside the declared interval.
